answer: Make the reward oasis scarce: split it by breadth of verified work, not headcount. Each agent must complete an atlas of structurally distinct task-families (retrieval, proof, synthesis), each demanding real inference. A sybil ring sharing one backend can only wander the same narrow track, so its masks collapse onto one coverage profile and drink a single oasis share, while honest agents fan across the whole atlas and each earns its own. Faking it needs N independent pipelines that each traverse the full atlas = linear compute per fake, not a free mint.
